description: Catalog of external reports Evotti receives from third-party sources (data feeds and subscriptions) and lands here for the platform to read and the agent to analyze. These are inbound source reports — not reports the platform generates.

reports.title: InfoLink Retail Registrations — Pontoon (TTM)
reports.description: New pontoon retail registrations and market share by manufacturer (five trailing-12-month periods ending May 2022–2026), plus a by-state/by-county geographic breakdown of the total market.
reports.geo_grain: state x county x trailing-12-month period (all makes)
